hypothesis: Class-common CKKS error cancels in score differences; calibrating the maximum pairwise error may avoid unnecessary abstention
residual: For each input, max over calibration keys of (max_c error_c - min_c error_c), where error_c = decrypted_c - plaintext_c
gate: Return observed top class if observed top-two gap exceeds the calibrated maximum pairwise-error radius; else abstain
scope: Multiclass outputs only, K>=2; reuse DP_PILOT_V1A square MLP models and already observed calibration/test logits
statistical_claim: None. This is an offline diagnostic on exposed pilot data; it does not inherit the IID audit of the different two-stage interval policy.
